name: Galaxy Digital
summary: Galaxy Digital Inc. engages in the digital asset and data centre infrastructure businesses in North America and internationally. It operates through Digital Assets, Data Centers, and Treasury and Corporate segments. The Digital Assets segment provides over-the-counter spot and derivatives trading, lending, and structured products, as well as mergers and acquisitions advisory, and equity and debt capital markets services. This segment also manages investments in the digital assets' ecosystem; and offers blockchain-centric technology and infrastructure solutions, including staking, tokenization, and custodial technology.
